name: Rot Blossom
summary: Rot Blossoms are foul, necrotic flora found growing among the desecrated graves of Duskwood. Fed by the blighted soil and undead remains, they are sought after for their potent, unwholesome alchemical properties.

sections.title: Flora of the Crypts
sections.body: Duskwood's unnatural corruption breeds bizarre and disturbing plant life, none more unsettling than the Rot Blossom. Rooted in the defiled earth of graveyards such as the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, these morbid blooms thrive in proximity to death. Local rumors claim they can even take root within the cracked skulls of the walking dead, particularly Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends that stalk the barrows. To the locals in Darkshire, harvesting them is both a grim chore and a dangerous necessity, as disturbing their soil means braving the unrested dead.

sections.title: A Gruesome Ingredient
sections.body: Despite their repulsive nature, Rot Blossoms serve a specialized purpose in local concoctions. The blooms contain dark essences required to brew Zombie Juice, a foul draft tied to Duskwood's macabre survival efforts. Those dispatched to gather the blossoms often find themselves inadvertently aiding the Night Watch, culling the restless skeletons that wander the haunted gravesites in the process.

faq.q: Where can Rot Blossoms be found?
faq.answer: Rot Blossoms are found growing in the corrupted soil of Duskwood's burial grounds, particularly within the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, and are known to sprout from the remains of undead skeletal fiends.

faq.q: What are Rot Blossoms used for?
faq.answer: They are a key ingredient used by local brewers and alchemists to distill a potent, foul mixture known as Zombie Juice.

faq.q: Why do these blossoms grow in skeletons?
faq.answer: Duskwood's lingering dark magic infects both the earth and the restless dead. Rot Blossoms feed directly on necrotic corruption and decay, allowing them to sprout inside the skulls and ribcages of roaming skeletons.

faq.q: How does gathering Rot Blossoms help Darkshire?
faq.answer: Anyone venturing into places like the Tranquil Gardens to harvest the blossoms must inevitably cut down the Skeletal Horrors and Fiends that plague the grounds, providing much-needed relief to Althea Ebonlocke and the beleaguered Night Watch.

angles.text: Unlike standard herbs nurtured by light and rain, Rot Blossoms are foul botanical anomalies fed purely by necrotic rot and graveyard soil, offering a grim study in corrupted flora.
Venturing into the cursed soil to harvest these morbid blooms doubles as a service to the Night Watch, helping keep Darkshire's borders clear of ravenous skeletons.
